$comment: 📊️ Schema-first contract of the print visualization library: the chart-kind catalogue (🖼️assets/🔣️viz-catalog.json), the family option vocabularies, the demo data tables and the numeric probe protocol. Owned by the CATALOG agent; every family owner extends `x-semio-family-options` for its own families only. The `x-` annotations carry the vocabulary that pure JSON Schema cannot express per family; `🔨️modules/📊️visualization-gallery/🟦️.ts` enforces them. A catalogue entry must set an option exactly when its family declares the key here, and this is the authority for `variant` in particular: a family that declares `variant` renders a different geometry per variant, so every one of its kinds names one; a family that does not declare it takes none.

title.en: “D3-equivalent” algorithmic capabilities implied by the visualization catalogue
A user should be able to describe essentially any visualization as:
title.de: Jede Visualisierung soll sich beschreiben lassen als:

LocalizedText.$comment: 🌍 Every user-visible string exists in both languages; the document language selects one, there is no default.

TaxonomyLeafId.$comment: 🍃 `<taxonomy section>/<leaf slug>`, the identity of one line of 🖼️assets/📊️viz-taxonomy.md.

Kind.$comment: 🗂️ What the entry renders: a mark primitive, a chart preset, or a demonstrated kernel capability.

Namespace.$comment: 📦 Taxonomy §76 namespace the renderer lives in, matching the `semio-viz-<namespace>` packages.

DemoTable.$comment: 🧪 Name of a demo table declared in a `%region 🔖️DemoData` block.

FamilyOptions.$comment: 🎛️ One family's option vocabulary: `variant` is required, further keys are the real dimensions the family exposes.

TaxonomyGroup.$comment: 📑 One group heading of the taxonomy, titled in both document languages.

TaxonomySection.$comment: 📚 One chapter of the taxonomy, titled in both document languages for the generated gallery.

DemoTableDeclaration.$comment: 🧫 A named demo table every catalogue entry may point at through its `data` key.

CatalogEntry.$comment: 📇 One chart kind: a family plus its default options, covering one or more taxonomy leaves.

ProbeRecord.$comment: 🔬 One line of `\jobname.probe.jsonl`, written by semio-viz-probe.sty and read by 🔨️modules/🧪️viz-probe.

GalleryTheme.$comment: 🌗 The document appearances a gallery section is rendered in.

GalleryKindPage.$comment: 📄️ Where one catalogue kind of a section landed: its one-based page and that page's extracted text.

GalleryVariantMeasurement.$comment: 📏️ One rendered gallery variant (section x theme x language): page count, per-kind page and page text, and the rebuild-stable PDF hash.

GalleryRenderEvidence.$comment: 🖼️ The committed gallery evidence of the `🖼️gallery-render` case, keyed `<section>/<theme>/<language>`; regenerated by `bun ./📜️script.ts test viz fixtures [section…]`, never hand-written.

options.description: Native guide controls. Authored at, from, to and center coordinates use a Cartesian origin at the bottom left; polar angles run counterclockwise from the positive horizontal axis. Inference projects them into the drawing scene.
